info.description: Routes of OpenVibe.Inventory as the OpenVibe contracts describe them (openvibe-contracts 0.130.0): each operation lists the capabilities it performs; a token for the service's audience must carry one of them unless the route is open. Generated by openvibe-contracts lib/openapi.js; do not edit.

errors.problem.v1.title: Problem
errors.problem.v1.description: RFC 9457 problem details (application/problem+json) with a stable OpenVibe error code and trace identifiers. The legacy 'error' string is allowed during migration so existing clients keep working.

error.description: Deprecated compatibility field: same text as title/detail for clients that read {error}.

inventory.definition-request.v1.title: InventoryDefinitionRequest
inventory.definition-request.v1.description: Create or edit a definition in the issuer's namespace (inventory.definition.manage). A service's or app's definition is published when it asks; a creator's goes to staff review (in_review) first.

media_id.description: An OpenVibe.Media object (an image, an animation).

token.description: A token the kind's renderers know (a CSS class, a speech preset).

publish.description: Ask for publication (a creator's definition goes to review).

grantors.description: Other services or apps the issuer lets grant this one item (ADR-054 §3): Quest giving Live's hats as quest rewards. They grant only (origin earned or granted, idempotent per key); defining, editing, consuming and revoking stay the issuer's.

inventory.definition.v1.title: InventoryDefinition
inventory.definition.v1.description: An item definition (ADR-054 §2): one item of a kind, issued by a service, an app or a creator, with an honest rarity, attributes valid against the kind and an optional supply cap. Published definitions can be granted; retired ones cannot, and their instances stay.

media_id.description: An OpenVibe.Media object (an image, an animation).

token.description: A token the kind's renderers know (a CSS class, a speech preset).

rarity.description: Shown as is; any odds that apply are shown with it, never hidden.

aliases.description: Earlier ids of the same item (Live's fx_rainbow, hat_crown, …).

credit.description: The creator of a community item (ADR-054 §6).

grantors.description: Other services or apps the issuer lets grant this one item (ADR-054 §3): Quest giving Live's hats as quest rewards. They grant only (origin earned or granted, idempotent per key); defining, editing, consuming and revoking stay the issuer's.

inventory.equip-request.v1.title: InventoryEquipRequest
inventory.equip-request.v1.description: Equip an instance the person owns in one slot of its kind, or clear the slot (instance_id null). One item per slot; equipping replaces what was there.

inventory.equipped.v1.title: InventoryEquipped
inventory.equipped.v1.description: What a person has equipped (ADR-054 §2), keyed <kind>:<slot>. Surfaces read it in batches (inventory.equipped-batch@1) and cache it briefly.

token.description: The definition's art token, so a renderer needs no second read.

media_id.description: The definition's art image (an OpenVibe.Media object), so a renderer needs no second read.

inventory.grant-request.v1.title: InventoryGrantRequest
inventory.grant-request.v1.description: An issuer grants one instance of a definition it issued to a person (inventory.item.grant). Idempotent per idempotency_key: a repeat answers the instance already granted. A capped definition that is sold out answers 409 inventory.supply_exhausted.

reason.description: Shown in the ledger: what the person did (a quest, an event, a milestone).

inventory.instance.v1.title: InventoryInstance
inventory.instance.v1.description: One item a person owns (ADR-054 §2): a definition, its origin and state. bought and traded are reserved for the later money ADR (ADR-054 §5) and are refused until it is accepted.

attributes.description: Per-instance values (a serial number, a wear value), valid against the kind.

serial.description: The instance's number within a capped supply.

inventory.inventory.v1.title: InventoryList
inventory.inventory.v1.description: A person's inventory page: their instances, newest first, with the definitions they refer to. The public read shows only owned instances of published definitions; the person's own read (inventory.item.list) also shows consumed and revoked ones.

inventory.review-request.v1.title: InventoryReviewRequest
inventory.review-request.v1.description: Staff's decision on a Workshop definition in review (ADR-054 §6): publish it (optionally with an honest rarity other than common) or reject it with a reason the creator sees.

reason.description: Required for reject: what the creator reads.

openvibeToken.description: An OpenVibe Network token for this service: a person's token, an app token (client credentials, audience of the service) or a first-party service token. Its `cap` claim must include the capability the operation names.
